patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with strong, contrasting background colors define distinct content blocks, often featuring asymmetrical content arrangements within them (e.g., text on one side, illustration or card on the other).
A clear typographic hierarchy uses oversized, bold display headings for impact, complemented by smaller, often monospaced or technical-looking body text and uppercase labels.
A high-contrast and distinctive palette combines deep, muted purples/browns with vibrant, almost neon pinks and softer lavender tones, creating a bold and energetic feel.

The initial hero section slides upwards to reveal the subsequent content, with a distinct pink geometric pattern at its base also animating out of view during the scroll transition. The main navigation remains sticky at the top.
Sections are introduced with large, single-word titles (e.g., 'Do', 'One', 'The') that act as visual anchors and break up the content flow.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations where the initial hero section slides upwards to reveal the content below, with a distinct geometric pattern also animating out of view during the scroll transition. The primary navigation bar maintains a sticky position at the top of the viewport.

Content is structured using full-width, high-contrast color blocks for each major section. Within these blocks, content is often arranged in an asymmetrical two-column layout, balancing large typography with illustrative elements or card-like components.
Interactive elements like buttons and cards consistently feature a subtle to rounded corner radius, contributing to a cohesive visual language.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, often monospaced or standard sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded, consistently applied to buttons, cards, and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-bleed sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast color palette of deep purples/browns and vibrant pinks, combined with a technical, almost retro-futuristic typographic style. This creates an energetic and memorable aesthetic that avoids generic corporate design, making a strong visual statement for a tech product.
